page.notes: The scan shows the upper part of the page only; the text runs on past the cut. The left margin note "graniusiu-diciu" is read as "grauius iu-dicium" and is doubtful. The note beside "Nota" reads "secü-da", taken as "secun-da". The Toletan reference "c. s.si" is read as "c. 5. Si" and is doubtful. The ampersand is written as & to keep the XML valid. The note mark "c" at "ducere" is matched to the left-margin note, which reads "Summa Angelic. dicti. Papa." ("dicti." uncertain). The final word of the first paragraph is printed "disce" with a Cyrillic-looking e; read as Latin "dice" with the printed spelling of the scan; treat as [?]. Bottom right "cx" taken as a signature with [?]. The final line ends mid-sentence with "nō" as printed.
